name: Wiseman Psychedelics
start: sudo service docker start && (docker start wiseman-pg || docker run --name wiseman-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=wiseman -p 5432:5432 -d postgres:16)

terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: cd backend && until ./venv/bin/python -c "import socket; s=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1', 5432), 1); s.close()"; do sleep 1; done && ./venv/bin/uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: cd frontend && HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=3000 BROWSER=none npm start
